criteria.requirement: Extend JSONL adapter with decimal_policy="float"|"string" and strict_json=False. Keep old defaults. String policy encodes every Decimal (including nested ones) as exact decimal text preserving scale; strict mode rejects nonfinite Decimal and float values anywhere, including string-policy Decimal NaN. Use per-call encoder settings without changing global JSON encoder state, preserve ordinary strings, large integers, unicode modes and input values, and reject invalid policy arguments before reading rows.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
